README声明0.3.8支持多个宿主范围，安装及兼容未在本轮验证。

#### 成本
| 阶段 | 现金与资源成本 | 人工与时间投入 | 已知条件与未知项 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 首次使用 | 已有宿主与模型资源 | 确认预设所有权、预算与权限 | 配置耗时未知 |
| 持续使用 | 父子调用、压缩、存储 | 委派回收、真实测试和经验清理 | 总账单需含失败 |
| 失败恢复 | 重试和旧任务读取 | pending持久化、过期binding排查 | 不盲重放写操作 |
| 外部 MCP 接入 | DSH 模型与原调用方验收的双边用量 | 客户端配置、token 管理、目录授权和产物回读 | 不可只统计 Codex 侧 token；同一工作树排他 |

熟悉DSH且已有代码验收流程的开发者可在独立分支试用。首次加载预设并确认安装所有权冲突、模型权限与删除模式；持续成本包括父子模型调用、上下文、压缩、检查和长期记忆维护，不能只看调用次数。可选storageDomain不可用会保留任务记忆但失去长期记忆。失败后检查pending持久化和旧binding，不盲重放写工具；以项目原测试、需求对照、总费用与人工时间共同验收。简单任务不应强建台账，未测到收益或出现未经确认的范围扩展就退回宿主原预设。 [Q04](#research-q04)

#### 效果
| 效果项 | 当前证据支持 | 尚不能确定 |
|---|---|---|
| 来源一致 | 用户事件quote核对 | 需求理解是否充分 |
| 交接防陈旧 | binding含修订版本 | 子任务正确性 |
| 分层记忆 | 工作区topic读取 | 长期增效和费用 |
| 作者评测 | 有条件和修正规则文档 | 当前提交同条件效果 |
| 跨客户端执行 | 本机六工具接真实宿主会话 | 尚未证明指定研究协议、报告质量或全链 token 节省 |
将execution归宿主、任务binding和源码引用验证写成独立模块是可借鉴点。安装器先存意图与所有权检查减少重启反复写风险；预算bridge依赖宿主compaction契约，升级需专项核查。 [Q06](#research-q06) 可借鉴先持久化派发意图、稳定请求去重、rpcId 对应观测以及执行结束与验收分离；移植须重建宿主事件适配与权限范围。

[Q01](#research-q01) 与 [Q02](#research-q02) 的主要增量在需求来源可核查、任务修订绑定与分层上下文，而执行loop和spawn继承宿主。它改善协作材料的可审查性，不能把reviewable直接当补丁正确。 [Q06](#research-q06) 的本机 MCP 以请求去重、目录白名单和可观测会话把 DSH 接为外部执行 worker；这增加跨客户端交接路径，模型执行仍归宿主。
[Q03](#research-q03) 指出成员checks与cost仍可自报，结构一致不证明完成验收；历史冻结候选评测亦不能直接套到固定0.3.8和新宿主。默认宽松删除提示不是全面删除防线。 [Q06](#research-q06) 进一步说明服务级 Bearer 不是多用户隔离，finished 不是报告验收，单工作树排他也限制并发。
[Q05](#research-q05) 提出宿主事件按任务attempt归因、按合格结果反馈预算，尚未验证；必须同时看完整账单和补丁质量，漏记或降质会推翻优势。

technical.rationale: novelty为任务来源/修订binding与上下文组合；mechanism明确拒绝旧交接并约束记忆；transferability可借鉴但依赖宿主事件和domain；simplification复用宿主loop，仍有台账和预算维护。 [Q06](#research-q06) 的 http.ts/tasks.ts 复用标准 MCP，以请求意图与去重组合产生实质机制增量，仍不是新执行引擎；保留50%档的 novelty/mechanism/transferability/simplification，缺跨客户端实际验证不取75%。

business.rationale: workflow明确委派与回收责任；delivery让需求到证据交接可追溯但仍需测试验收；reach主要开发者；economics有预算调节机制而无固定版本净收益实测。 [Q06](#research-q06) 跨客户端委派扩展交接，但未改变最终正确性责任：workflow/delivery保留50%，reach/economics仅25%推断，未测全链费用不升档。

recommendation.reason: 熟悉DSH且有项目验收流程的开发者可在独立分支试用需求绑定的跨文件任务委派。相比原生预设的松散交接，源码能拒绝旧版本或错owner的结果，合格补丁率和总费用改善未测。出现未经授权的范围扩展、pending状态不明或结果仅自报通过时，应停止委派并退回原预设及项目测试人工验收。

scenario.rationale: 依据[Q01](#research-q01)、[Q02](#research-q02)，README第85—105行及src/dsh/super-code.ts第76—94行聚焦跨文件调查、实现、验证的任务。需求在父子交接时改变、工作区版本不一致是具体流程摩擦，合格结果是通过原项目验收的补丁而非台账，支持23分高于15分。普通宿主已有子Agent，简单任务不需台账；缺少当前版本真实开发负担与持续采用材料，不取30分，历史评测不能直接证明本任务值得采用。

advantage.rationale: 依据[Q02](#research-q02)、[Q03](#research-q03)，src/core/delegation.ts第28—55行把session、需求修订、工作区、版本、owner和attempt绑定，过期交接不能进入reviewable，相比普通文字委派有明确实质改善，取19分高于13分。reviewable仍不证明artifacts与checks真实，maxTokens不认证账单，默认删除relaxed也不是通用阻断，故不取25分。宿主负责模型loop与子Agent执行，不能归本插件原创；历史56%和节费结论不继承到当前固定代码。

evidence.rationale: 依据[Q02](#research-q02)、[Q03](#research-q03)、[Q04](#research-q04)，实际核查src/core/delegation.ts第28—55行，代码明确版本匹配只使可审阅且cost为model-reported，deletion-protection.ts第58—71行另定位有限命令保护。核心委派、结果校验及关键负面边界都有固定源码，取13分超过局部入口6分。未执行任务、存储恢复和项目测试，不能取19分；评测文档对应其他冻结候选，不能升级成当前真实宿主效果证据。 本次[Q06](#research-q06)另核查 http.ts:26—55、tasks.ts:45—87、connection-host.ts:60—87，覆盖 MCP 到真实会话及主要失败边界，仍为源码级13分，不因作者兼容表升级。

cost.rationale: 依据[Q03](#research-q03)、[Q04](#research-q04)，src/dsh/index.ts第20—30行与super-code.ts第102—121行显示预设和可选长期存储依赖，delegation.ts第50—55行账单自报不完整。操作者需维护预设所有权、权限、删除模式、父子上下文与pending状态，持续成本显著，但独立分支、原测试及退原预设有可行路径，取10分高于5分。未测总模型费用和人工校验量，不能取15分；Git分支只给版本退路，不是外部写入隔离。 [Q06](#research-q06) 的 Bearer、profile、目录授权及工作树排他增加外部接入维护，须计双方模型与验收开销，维持10而非15分。

Record<string, PropertyDescriptor | undefined>): void {\n  ctx.effect(() => () => {\n    const target = reference.deref()\n    if (!target) return\n    for (const [key, descriptor] of Object.entries(descriptors)) {\n      if (descriptor) Object.defineProperty(target, key, descriptor)\n      else Reflect.deleteProperty(target, key)\n    }\n  })\n}\n\nfunction mergedConfig(base: budgets.summaryMaxTokens,\n    compactionRetries: budgets.compactionRetries, maxOverflowRetries: budgets.maxOverflowRetries,\n  }).filter(([, value]) => value !== undefined))\n  const merge = (value: object) => {\n    const config = { ...value, ...overrides } as Record<string, unknown>\n    if (budgets.retainRatio !== undefined) delete config.retainTokens\n    return config\n  }\n  return { engine.compactIfNeeded, region = engine.compactRegion, now = engine.compactNow\n  const run: RunPolicy = (agent, action) => {\n    const selected = policy(agent)\n    return selected ? budgets.pressureBasis === 'window' && trigger === 'pressure'\n    ? compactByWindow(engine, budgets, agent, signal) : pressure.call(engine, agent, trigger, signal))\n  engine.compactRegion = (start, end, agent, signal) => run(agent, () => region.call(engine, start, end, agent, signal))\n  engine.compactNow = (agent, signal, command) => run(agent, () => now.call(engine, agent, signal, command))\n this.service().read() : { configuration: structuredClone(defaultConnectionConfig), revision: 0, writable: false, state: 'error', error: 'unavailable', url: '' } }\n  @Remote\n  saveConfig(content: string, expected: string): Promise<ConnectionSaveResult> { return this.service().save(content, expected) }\n  @Remote\n  revealToken(): { token: string } { return this.service().reveal() }\n  @Remote\n  rotateToken(expected: string): Promise<ConnectionSaveResult> { return this.service().rotate(expected) }\n  @Remote\n  overview(): ReturnType<ConnectionService['overview']> { return this.current() ? this.service().overview() : { connections: [], sessions: [] } }\n  @Remote\n  disconnectClient(id: string): Promise<{ disconnected: true }> { return this.service().disconnect(id) }\n  @Remote\n  pendingDirectories(): ReturnType<ConnectionService['pendingDirectories']> { return this.current() ? this.service().pendingDirectories() : [] }\n  @Remote\n  resolveDirectory(id: string, decision: string): ReturnType<ConnectionService['resolveDirectory']> { return this.service().resolveDirectory(id, decision) }\n  @Remote\n  async directories(): Promise<{ items: { path: string; title: string; available: boolean; workspace: boolean }[]; picker: string; available: boolean }> {\n    const workspaces = this.environment.workspaces ? this.environment.workspaces.list() : []\n    const config = this.current() ? this.service().read().configuration : defaultConnectionConfig\n    // Registry entities expose these fields through prototype getters.\n    const rows = [...workspaces.map(row => ({ path: row.path, title: row.title, workspace: true })),\n      ...[...config.knownDirectories, ...config.allowedDirectories].map(path => ({ path, title: '', workspace: false }))]\n    const items = await Promise.all(rows.slice(0, 500).map(async row => {\n      try { const path = await realpath(row.path); return { path, title: row.title, workspace: row.workspace, available: (await stat(path)).isDirectory() } }\n      catch { return { path: row.path, title: row.title, workspace: row.workspace, available: false } }\n    }))\n    return { items: items.filter((row, index) => items.findIndex(other => other.path === row.path) === index),\n      picker: this.environment.picker ? this.environment.picker.capability().kind : 'unavailable', available: !!this.environment.workspaces }\n  }\n  @Remote\n  async pickDirectory(signal: AbortSignal): Promise<{ kind: 'selected'; path: string } | { kind: 'cancelled' }> {\n    const picker = this.environment.picker && this.environment.picker.capability()\n    if (!picker || picker.kind !== 'native' || !picker.pick) throw new ConnectionError('picker-unavailable')\n    const path = await picker.pick(signal)\n    return path === null ? { kind: 'cancelled' } : { kind: 'selected', path }\n  }\n  @Remote\n  async browseDirectory(path: string, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<DirectoryListing> {\n    const picker = this.environment.picker && this.environment.picker.capability()\n    if (!picker || picker.kind !== 'browse' || !picker.list) throw new ConnectionError('picker-unavailable')\n    return picker.list(path || undefined, signal)\n  }\n}\nexport function applyConnection(ctx: Context): void {\n  let service: ConnectionService | false = false\n  const environment: SettingsEnvironment = { workspaces: false, picker: false }\n  new SuperCodeConnection(ctx, () => service, environment)\n  ctx.inject(['workspaceRegistry'], owner => {\n    environment.workspaces = owner.get('workspaceRegistry')\n    owner.effect(() => () => { environment.workspaces = false })\n  })\n  ctx.inject(['directoryPicker'], owner => {\n    environment.picker = owner.get('directoryPicker')\n    owner.effect(() => () => { environment.picker = false })\n  })\n  const profileServices = 'profileContext' in ctx ? ['profileContext'] : []\n  ctx.inject([...profileServices, 'sessionController', 'agents', 'sessionQuery', 'subagents', 'superCodePresets'], async owner => {\n    let directory: string\n    try {\n      if (profileServices.length) {\n        const profile = owner.get('profileContext') as { patchPath: string }\n        directory = dirname(profile.patchPath)\n      } else {\n        // Early hosts expose the profile only as the boot context base URL. Verify its manifest.\n        const baseUrl = owner.root.baseUrl\n        if (!baseUrl) throw new Error('Profile base URL unavailable')\n        directory = fileURLToPath(baseUrl)\n        const manifest = JSON.parse(await readFile(join(directory, 'package.json'), 'utf8'))\n        if (!Array.isArray(manifest.dsh?.profile?.bundles)) throw new Error('Not a profile')\n      }\n    } catch { owner.logger.warn('Super Code connection requires a persistent host profile.'); return }\n    const host = new ConnectionHost({ presets: owner.get('superCodePresets'), controller: owner.get('sessionController'),\n      agents: owner.get('agents'), query: owner.get('sessionQuery'), subagents: owner.get('subagents') } as ConnectionHostServices)\n    const connection = new ConnectionService(new ConnectionStore(join(directory, 'super-code-connection')), host)\n    try {\n      await connection.initialize()\n      service = connection\n      owner.effect(() => () => { service = false; return connection.close() })\n    } catch { owner.logger.warn('Super Code connection storage is unavailable or already owned by another host. No endpoint was started.') }\n  })\n}\n"
